Date  06 MARS 2026

 

Avis à Manifestation d’Intérêt : 2026/002/AMI/STATCAP-KM/Consultant-Agricol

Recrutement d’un consultant International en appui à la réalisation de l’enquête Agricole

1. Contexte

 

L’Union des Comores a reçu un financement de la Banque Mondiale (BM) pour couvrir le coût du Projet d’Investissement de Soutien aux Capacités Statistiques de la communauté de Développement de l’Afrique Australe (STATCAP-KM) et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie des sommes accordées au titre de ce don pour financer le « recrutement d’un consultant International en appui à la réalisation de l’enquête Agricole. Dans ce cadre, il est prévu la réalisation d’une une Enquête Agricole Annuelle visant à produire des statistiques fiables sur les exploitations agricoles, les rendements, la production, les pratiques culturales et les filières stratégiques. Afin d’assurer la conformité aux standards internationaux (FAO, ODD, bonnes pratiques statistiques) et aux exigences des partenaires techniques et financiers, l’INSEED recrute un(e) consultant(e) international(e) pour appuyer l’ensemble du cycle de l’enquête.

 

C’est dans ce contexte que le projet envisage de recruter un consultant international afin d’apporter un appui technique de haut niveau couvrant l’ensemble du processus d’enquête : conception méthodologique, élaboration des outils, supervision de la collecte, apurement, traitement, analyse et publication des résultats.

 

2. Qualifications

 

Formation :

Diplôme minimum requis : Ingénieur des Travaux Statistiques (ITS) ou Master II en Statistique, Économétrie, Démographie ou domaine connexe ;

 

 

Expérience :

  1. Une expérience supplémentaire (Doctorat) constitue un atout ;
  2. Minimum 8 à 10 ans d’expérience en conception et conduite d’enquêtes agricoles ou socio-économiques à grande échelle ;
  3. Expérience confirmée dans l’élaboration de plans d’échantillonnage complexes et systèmes de pondération ;
  4. Maîtrise des logiciels statistiques (STATA, R ou équivalent) ;
  5. Expérience dans des contextes similaires (Afrique, petits États insulaires) souhaitée ;
  6. Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles en français

Les consultants intéressées doivent fournir un dossier de candidature comprenant : une lettre de motivation, un CV détaillé mettant en évidence les qualifications et expériences et les copies et attestations de travail.

 

Les Termes de Référence (TDR) détaillés  peuvent être obtenus à l’adresse indiquée ci -dessous ,les dossiers de candidatures doivent être envoyées au même adresse au plus tard le 3 avril 2026.

 

 A l attention du coordinateur du projet STATCAP-KM

Adresse: Moroni-Union des Comores

Tél : 00269 365 53 04

Email : recrutement.statcap@gmail.com

República de Moçambique

Ministério da Juventude e Desporto

Solicitação de Manifestação de Interesse –

Mapeamento da Demanda e da Oferta de Emprego para Jovens por Sector de Formação e Por Género nas Regiões Norte, Centro e Sul – Acredita Emprega

 

O Governo de Moçambique, através do Instituto Nacional da Juventude, IP instituição tutelada pelo Ministro da Juventude e Desporto, com o suporte do Banco Mundial, está a implementar um projecto designado “Empoderamento e Resiliência das Raparigas da África Oriental”, e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos para a contratação de um Consultor Individual para realizar o  Mapeamento da Demanda e da Oferta de Emprego para Jovens por Sector de Formação  e Por Género nas Regiões Norte, Centro e Sul – Acredita Emprega

 

Objectivos da Contratação

O Consultor será contratado para apoiar o Projecto no mapeamento da demanda e da oferta de emprego por sector de actividade nos Distritos seleccionados, tendo em vista permitir que os beneficiários tenham acesso a oportunidades económicas através da prestação de serviços subsidiados

 

 Qualificações e Experiência

O candidato a esta posição deverá possuir as seguintes qualificações:

 

  • Formação superior nas áreas de Gestão, Economia, Administração Pública ou outras áreas relevantes;
  • Experiência em métodos quantitativos e qualitativos de investigação.
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, incluindo a capacidade de fornecer análises criteriosas sobre mapeamentos;
  • Experiência comprovada em estudos de mercado de trabalho, análise de competências ou planeamento de TVET.
  • Conhecimento do contexto socioeconómico de Moçambique.
  • Capacidade de articulação com entidades públicas e privadas;
  • Habilidades de comunicação e capacidade para apresentar, negociar, e resolver questões complexas;
  • Fluência na comunicação escrita e oral em língua portuguesa;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão;
  • Excelente capacidade de organização;
  • Domínio da informática na óptica do utilizador;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipa.

 

O Instituto Nacional da Juventude, IP - Unidade de Gestão do Projecto, convida consultores individuais elegíveis a manifestarem o seu interesse em realizar o serviço. Os Consultores interessados devem submeter informações demonstrando que possuem qualificações e experiência relevantes e necessárias para executar os serviços.

 

O processo de selecção será de acordo com os procedimentos estabelecidos no Regulamento de Aquisições para Mutuários do IPF do Banco Mundial, 5ª Edição, Setembro de 2023.

Os interessados poderão obter informações adicionais e solicitar os Termos de Referência através do e-mail: eagerprocurement@gmail.com


Os interessados deverão enviar uma carta de manifestação de interesse, bem como o Curriculum Vitae, em português, e suas experiências, para o endereço abaixo, até 15h30 do dia 26 de Março de 2026, com a seguinte descrição: “ MZ-MJD-535031-CS-INDV Mapeamento da Demanda e da Oferta de Emprego para Jovens por Sector de Formação e Por Género nas Regiões Norte, Centro e Sul – Acredita Emprega

This Specific Procurement Notice for Request for Bids (RFB) follows the General Procurement Notice (GPN) No. OP00126428 for this project that appeared in UN Development Business on 22nd April 2021.

Punjab Rural Municipal Services Company (PRMSC) (hereinafter referred to as “Company”) is a government-owned not-for-profit company, incorporated with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan, under Section 42 of the Companies Act, 2017. The Company has been registered as a dedicated water, sanitation, and waste management service provider for rural areas of Punjab and is envisioned to be customer-oriented and responsive to the WASH needs of rural populations.

The Government of Islamic Republic of Pakistan has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of the Punjab Rural Sustainable Water Supply and Sanitation Project (PRSWSSP) for improving service delivery standards of the rural water & sanitation system and has extended the said financing to Company. Under Component 1 viz. Sanitation and Water Supply infrastructure Development, of the Project, the Company has aimed at developing the infrastructure to help in addressing the lack of Water Supply & Sanitation Systems in 2,000 revenue villages (including the small habitations/basis in each Revenue Village) of sixteen (16) poorest and most underserved districts of Rural Punjab that underlies the low access to safely managed water and sanitation and poses threats to public health and the environment. Over 6.0 million rural residents shall be served under the said component which will be implemented in phased manner.

REPUBLIQUE DE GUINEE

                                                MINISTERE DE L’ENERGIE                                                                     

                                          ELECTRICITE DE GUINEE (EDG SA)                                                                                                               

                               Projet d’Amélioration d’Accès à l’Electricité en Guinée Phase 2 (PAAEG 2)

                                                                              Sélection d’un Consultant firme

                                                               DEMANDE DE MANIFESTATIONS D’INTERET

 

Financement PAAEG 2 : P511453/ IDA Crédits N° 7869 GN, N° 7870 GN et N° 7882 GN

Conakry le 16 mars 2026

Sélection d’un cabinet pour les Vérifications indépendantes (IAV) des conditions liées aux PBCs au compte du PAAEG 2.

 

La phase 2 du Projet d’Amélioration de l’Accès à l’Electricité en Guinée (PAAEG 2) a reçu un financement de la Banque mondiale pour couvrir les coûts du projet PAAEG 2 et la Société Electricité de Guinée (EDG SA) a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce financement pour effectuer des paiements au titre de services de consultants pour la mission de Vérification Indépendante de la réalisation des quatre (4) conditions basées sur les performances (PBCs) mises en œuvre par la Société Electricité de Guinée conformément au protocole de vérification, au cahier des charges et à la méthodologie convenue, pour permettre les décaissements des montants liés à ces conditions et assurer la performance du secteur de l’électricité en Guinée.

Le Projet d’Amélioration de l’Accès à l’Electricité en Guinée (PAAEG 2) invite les firmes de consultants (« Consultants ») admissibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et une expérience pertinente pour l’exécution des Services.

Les critères pour l’établissement de la liste retreinte sont :

(i) les activités principales et le nombre d’années d’exercices ;

  • Être un Cabinet d’expertise comptable ou un groupement de cabinets, inscrit à un ordre reconnu et spécialisés dans l’audit ou Conseil avec une expérience minimum de dix (10) ans.
  • Avoir au moins dix (10) ans d’expériences, dans les domaines de l’audit, de vérification des Indicateurs Liés au Décaissement (ILD), de vérification des Conditions Basées sur la Performance (CBP) ou du suivi évaluation.

 (ii) l’expérience voulue (ou similaire) ;

  • Avoir réalisé au moins trois (03) missions de vérification des Conditions Basées sur la Performance (CBP) ou de vérification d’Indicateurs Liés aux Décaissements (ILD)dans le cadre de projets relatifs à la   gestion publique incluant l’administration centrale, les services techniques déconcentrés, les Etablissements publics, et les collectivités locales au cours des cinq (5) dernières années

(iii) la capacité technique et administrative de l’entreprise (Agrément/ou organisation)

Ce qui pourrait correspondre à la répartition ci-après : (i) Expérience générale (30 points); Expériences similaires (60 points); et (iii) organisation (10 points).

Veuillez noter les dispositions additionnelles suivantes relatives au conflit d’intérêts dans le cadre des Services objet de la présente Sollicitation de manifestation d’intérêt :

Les Consultants ne peuvent être engagés pour des missions qui seraient incompatibles avec leurs obligations présentes ou passées envers d’autres clients, ou qui risqueraient de les mettre dans l’impossibilité de remplir leur mandat au mieux des intérêts de l’Emprunteur. Sans préjudice du caractère général de ces dispositions, les Consultants ne peuvent être engagés dans les circonstances énoncées ci-après :

  1. Aucune entreprise engagée par l’Emprunteur pour livrer des Fournitures, réaliser des Travaux ou fournir des Services Autres que des Services des Consultants pour un projet (ni aucune entreprise affiliée qui la contrôle directement ou indirectement, qu’elle contrôle elle-même ou qui est placée sous un contrôle commun) n’est admise à fournir des Services de Consultants consécutifs ou directement liés à ces Fournitures, Travaux ou Services Autres que des Services de Consultants. Cette disposition ne s’applique pas aux diverses entreprises (Consultants, entrepreneurs ou fournisseurs) qui, collectivement, s’acquittent des obligations de l’adjudicataire d’un marché clés en main ou d’un marché de conception – construction :
  2. Aucune entreprise engagée par l’emprunteur pour fournir des Services de Consultants pour la préparation ou l’exécution d’un projet (ni aucune entreprise affiliée qui contrôle directement ou indirectement, qu’elle contrôle elle-même ou qui est placée sous un contrôle commun) n’est admise ultérieurement à livrer des Fournitures réaliser des Travaux ou fournit des Services Autres que des Services de Consultants consécutifs ou directement liés audits Services de Consultants. Cette disposition ne s’applique pas aux diverses entreprises (consultant, entrepreneurs ou fournisseurs) qui, collectivement, s’acquittent des obligations de l’adjudicataire d’un marché clés en main ou d’un marché de conception construction
  3. Aucun Consultant (y compris le personnel et les sous-consultants à son service) ni aucun prestataire affilié (qui le contrôle directement ou indirectement, qu’il contrôle lui-même ou qui est placé sous un contrôle commun) ne peut être engagé pour une mission qui par sa nature, crée un conflit d’intérêt avec une autre de ses missions ;
  4. Les Consultants (y compris les experts, le personnel et les sous-consultants à leur service) qui ont une relation professionnelle ou familiale étroite avec tout cadre de l’Emprunteur, de l’organisme d’exécution du projet, d’un bénéficiaire d’une fraction du financement de la ou de toute autre partie représentant l’Emprunteur ou agissant en son nom qui participe directement ou indirectement à tout segment :
  • De la préparation des Termes de référence de la mission ;

procnotices.notice_text:
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

 

Republic of Maldives

Sustainable and Integrated Labor Services (SAILS) Project

Loan No./Credit No./ Grant No.: E046-MV

 

Assignment Title: Design, Development, and Implementation of a National Labour Market Information System (LMIS)

Reference No. (as per Procurement Plan): MV-MOED-525705-CS-CQS

The Government of the Maldives has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Sustainable and Integrated Labor Services (SAILS) Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.

The consulting services (“the Services”) include Design, Development, and Implementation of a National Labour Market Information System (LMIS). The LMIS will serve as the authoritative national source for labor market statistics and intelligence. It will feature a public-facing portal for dynamic data exploration and analysis, and a secure backend for data management and inter-agency exchange. It is expected to complete the assignment within 12 (twelve) months from the date of contract signing. Post-Implementation Support) shall be given for a period of 12 months.

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment are attached to this request for expressions of interest.

The Ministry of Higher Education, Labour and Skills Development now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are:

  • Must be a reputable IT services or consulting firm with a minimum of 5 years of demonstrable experience in developing large-scale, data-intensive web applications for government or international organization clients.
  • Must provide evidence of successfully completing at least 1 project of similar scale and complexity within the last 5 years. Client references and project descriptions must be provided.
  • The bidding entity (which may be a single firm, a Joint Venture, or a lead firm with designated sub-consultants) must collectively demonstrate proven institutional experience and successful implementation of projects in two core areas
    • Statistical Data Systems: Verifiable, in-depth experience in the successful deployment and customization of statistical data platforms for national statistics or government context.
    • Data Visualization and User Experience: A portfolio of high-quality, large-scale web applications that demonstrate excellence in user-centric design, interactive data visualization, and the creation of intuitive analytical tools for non-technical users.
  • Must have proven experience in developing and consuming secure APIs, engineering complex ETL pipelines, and implementing business intelligence and data visualization solutions.
  • Experience with World Bank-funded projects and familiarity with World Bank procurement and reporting guidelines will be considered a significant advantage.

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

The selection of the Consultant will be conducted in accordance with the World Bank's “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (published in November 2020), using the Consultant's Qualification Selection (CQS) method.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours.

Expressions of interest must be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by mail, or by fax, or by e-mail) by 23rd March 2026, 15:00hrs.

procnotices.notice_text:
Specific Procurement Notice


Request for Bids


Plant Design, Supply and Installation
(Two-envelope Bidding Process, Without Prequalification)


Employer : Department of Information and Communications Technology
Project : Philippines Digital Infrastructure Project
Contract title : Detailed Design and Build for the National Fiber Backbone Phases 4 and 5
Country : Republic of the Philippines
Loan No. : 9730-PH
RFB No : PH-DICT-476160-A-CW-RFB-Rebid
Issued on : 06 March 2026


1. The Republic of the Philippines has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Philippines Digital Infrastructure Project (PDIP) and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for the Detailed Design and Build for the National Fiber Backbone Phases 4 and 5.


2. The Department of Information and Communications Technology now invites sealed Bids from the prospective Bidders for Detailed Design and Build for the National Fiber Backbone Phases 4 and 5 which includes the following: Design, Supply, Delivery and Installation, Testing, Commissioning, and Integration of Optical Transport Network, Telecom Shelter and Cable Entrance Facility.


3. Bidding will be conducted through International Competitive Procurement using Request for Bids (RFB) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (“Procurement Regulations”) September 2023 , and is open to all eligible Bidders as defined in the Procurement Regulations.


4. Bids will be evaluated in accordance with the evaluation process set out in the bidding documents. The following weightings shall apply for Rated Criteria: Technical and non-price factors: 60% Bid cost: 40%
5. Interested eligible Bidders may obtain further information from the details below and inspect the bidding document during office hours from 9:00 am to 4:00 pm at the address given below.


6. The bidding document in English language may be purchased by interested eligible Bidders upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of TEN THOUSAND PESOS (PhP 10,000.00). The method of payment may be any of the following:


a. Cash at the office address indicated below; or

b. Other mode of payment through DICT eProcurement system which may be accessed at https://eprocurement.dict.gov.ph;


7. Bids must be delivered to the address below on or before 17 April 2026 at 10:00 A.M. Electronic bidding will not be permitted. Late Bids will be rejected. The outer Bid envelopes marked “ORIGINAL BID”, and the inner envelopes marked “TECHNICAL PART” will be publicly opened in the presence of the Bidders’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below on 17 April 2026 at 10:00 A.M. All envelopes marked “FINANCIAL PART” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Employer until the second public Bid opening.


8. All Bids must be accompanied by a Bid-Securing Declaration.


9. Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful bidder’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the bidding document.


10. The address(es) referred to above is (are):


SPECIAL BIDS AND AWARD COMMITTEE

19/F Procurement Service

Studio 7, 807 Epifanio de los Santos Avenue, Diliman, Quezon City

Email Address: bac@dict.gov.ph or bac.secretariat@dict.gov.ph

Website: www.dict.gov.ph

Invitation to Participate in the Tender (Request for Quotation – RFQ)

Date: 04.03. 2026
Contract Identification Numbers: CEBU/RFQ/11
IDA Credit No.: 7172-UZ
Project Title: Clean Energy for Buildings in Uzbekistan (CEBU)

The Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan has received financing in the amount of USD 143.0 million from the World Bank, through the International Development Association (IDA), for the implementation of the Clean Energy for Buildings in Uzbekistan (CEBU) Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds of this credit to finance contracts for the provision of consulting and engineering services.

The procurement will be conducted in accordance with the World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers (July 2016, as amended from time to time). Eligible bidders from eligible countries are invited to participate.

The Project Implementation Unit (PIU) for the Clean Energy for Buildings in Uzbekistan Project hereby invites eligible and qualified bidders to submit quotations for the provision of the following services:

Technical inspection of structural elements of buildings Stage-1. Preliminary inspection of buildings under the following package CEBU/RFQ/11.

The scope and requirements of the services are described in detail in the Terms of Reference (TOR).

Interested eligible bidders may obtain additional information and review the RFQ documentation during working hours from 09:00 to 17:00.

The full set of RFQ documents may be obtained upon request and can be provided electronically.

Quotations may be submitted in hard copy or in electronic form, duly signed and stamped.

Deadline for submission of quotations:
12 March 2026, by 18:00 (Tashkent time).
Late submissions will not be considered.

Language of quotations: Russian.

GOVERNMENT OF PAKISTAN

BENAZIR INCOME SUPPORT PROGRAMME (BISP)

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANCY SERVICES)

The Benazir Income Support Programme (BISP), Government of Pakistan, has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the “Crisis Resilient Social Protection (CRISP) Program”. BISP intends to apply a portion of the proceeds of this financing to engage the services of Individual Consultants under the CRISP Program, which is funded by the World Bank;

Sr. No.

Position

Required Qualification & Experience

01.

NSER Coordinator

(01 Position)

Qualification: Minimum 16 years of education in Computer Science, Management Sciences, or any relevant field, from an HEC-recognized university.

 

Experience: At least 7 years of experience of working in similar domains. Having expertise in statistics, data sciences and data management will be essential. Strong comprehension, analytical reasoning and report writing skills are essential to the job requirements. Ability to compile, organize, interpret and analyse data from databases/various data sources, and present findings to stakeholders. Experience of working with large-scale Government projects and International Development Partners will be an asset.

02.

System & Storage Lead

(01 Position)

Qualifications:  Minimum Second Class or Grade ‘C’ or 2.5/4.0 CGPA, University degree (16 years of Education) or equivalent in Computer Sciences /Engineering/IT degree/ computer science or equivalent from a HEC recognized University / Institution.

 

Experience: 10-12+ years related IT experience in organization of repute. Proven experience of more than 8 years in field of Internetworking covering LAN, WAN, Intranet, extranet. Experience in administrating, designing, installing, Windows/Unix-based. operating system (OS includes Windows server 2016, Redhat, Ubuntu, CentOS). Experience in Virtualization VMware ESXI/Vspher, KVM and Windows Hyper V. Experience in Installing, administrating Mail Server using Microsoft. Exchange, Postfix/Sendmail/WHM/Cpanel. Experience in Installation and configuration SAN / NAS Storage. Windows 2016, 2020, 2022 based Domain Controller/ Additional Domain Controller. 

 

  • Detailed Terms of Reference (TORs) for the post can be downloaded from www.bisp.gov.pk.
  • The Consultant shall be selected in accordance with the method contained in Section VII, paragraphs,7.36 and 7.37 of the “World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers”, July 2016 [Revised November 2017 and August 2018] (“WB Procurement Regulations”), which can be perused at the website: https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/products-and-services/brief/procurement-new-framework
  • Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. T.A/D.A will not be admissible.
  • Remuneration would be negotiable commensurating to qualification and experience of the candidate.
  • The attention of interested eligible Individual Consultants is drawn to Section III. Paragraphs 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers July 2016, [Revised November 2017 and August 2018] (“WB Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.
  • Applications must be submitted online through BISP’s official website (www.bisp.gov.pk) within fifteen (15) days of publication of this advertisement.
  • Applicants are required to complete the prescribed “Online Application Form” and upload a detailed, updated CV.
  • Applications received via postal/courier service, email, or by hand will not be entertained.
  • The last date to apply for the post is 23rd March, 2026.

Director HR (Policy & Regulations)

Room No. 209, Second Floor

Assignment Title

Selection of a Consultancy firm for “Consulting Services for “Project Management and Technical Consultancy-Resilient Action for Development and Disaster Recovery (READY-HP) Project, Jal Shakti Vibhag (JSV) in the State of Himachal Pradesh in India.

Country of Delivery

India

The Government of Himachal Pradesh has requested a loan from the World Bank towards the cost of the Resilient Action for Development and Disaster Recovery (READY-HP), and intends to apply a part of the proceeds of this loan to pay for the Consultancy Services.

The objective of the consultancy (“the Services”) is to engage Project Management and Technical Consultant (PMTC) to provide specialized engineering, advisory and implementation support to the PIU housed in HPJSV Shimla and FIU at different zones for the effective delivery of the READY-HP Project. The Management and Technical Consultant will be responsible for the following, but not limited to following:

  1. Design, implementation and O&M of the proposed water supply, sanitation and irrigation works by developing risk-informed Detailed Project Reports (DPRs) with integration hydrological, geotechnical, and environmental and social aspects, conducting comprehensive E&S screening including ESIA/ESMP, technical guidance to PIU/FIU during implementation with two-tier quality assurance; and Institutional Strengthening for Resilience with focus on developing robust Quality Management System, developing institutional capacity through structured training, knowledge products, and SOPs & establishing and operationalising the Resilience, Efficiency, and Safety–Quality (RES-Q) Cell and strengthening the Water and Sanitation Support Organization (WSSO) for developing frameworks, manuals, and training on risk-informed DPRs and resilient construction practices.
  2. To develop and operationalise robust project management frameworks, work scheduling tools, contract tracking systems, Procurement as per World Bank’s regulations, contract management, and financial management, etc. Oversee and facilitate bidding document preparation, tender evaluations, and consultant/contractor onboarding—to ensure fairness, transparency, value for money & fit for purpose. Ensure adherence to the Project’s Environment and Social Management that is based on the national and state legal framework, and also the World Bank’s Environment and Social Framework ESF, fiduciary, and integrity guidelines. Institutionalize good project management practices and digital monitoring tools for long-term resilience building. The objective is also to achieve agreed-upon project monitoring indicators within the stipulated time frame.

 

The duration of the services will be 60 months for the overall project with two phases, i.e.  Phase I- 18 Months: DPR Development and Phase II- 42 Months: Technical Support and Supervision.

 

The Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services described in REOI. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they fulfill the below mentioned qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services:

Confirmation regarding availability of resources with a summary of qualifications and project experience.

The firm shall submit a list of key personnel/Experts already working on the payroll of the firm, along with proof certified by the firm and duly signed by an authorized signatory.

 

(No individual CVs required at this stage)

Financial Capacity

The firm shall have a Minimum annual turnover of Rs 25 Cr in any one of the last three financial years in Management and technical consultancy services.

Audited Financial Reports and CA Certificate for the last three financial years.

Debarment

procnotices.notice_text:
TERMS OF REFERENCE (TOR)

Individual Consultant

Preparation of the Program Operational Manual (POM)

EduImkon: Redesigning Opportunity, Delivering Education Equity Program

(IBRD Program-for-Results Financing)

 

1. Background

The Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan is implementing the EduImkon: Redesigning Opportunity, Delivering Education Equity Program (the Program), supported by financing from the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development under the Program-for-Results (PforR) instrument.

The objective of the Program is to improve equitable access, sustainability, and relevance of the student financing support mechanism in the tertiary education sector. Disbursements under the Program are linked to the achievement of Disbursement Linked Indicators (DLIs) and Disbursement Linked Results (DLRs), verified by an Independent Verification Agent (IVA).

In accordance with Schedule 2, Section I.C of the Loan Agreement, the Borrower is required to prepare and adopt a Program Operational Manual (POM) in form and substance acceptable to the World Bank. The POM serves as the primary operational reference governing institutional arrangements, fiduciary systems, verification protocols, environmental and social systems, monitoring, reporting, and amendment procedures for Program implementation.

To support the timely and high-quality preparation of the POM, the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) seeks to engage an Individual Consultant with strong expertise in World Bank PforR operations and operational documentation.

 

2. Objective of the Assignment

The objective of this assignment is to draft a comprehensive Program Operational Manual (POM) for the EduImkon Program that:

  • is fully aligned with the Loan Agreement, PAD, and World Bank PforR policy requirements;
  • translates legal and policy provisions into clear, practical, and implementable operational procedures; and
  • provides unambiguous guidance to all institutions involved in Program implementation.

 

3. Scope of Work

Under the overall supervision of the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), the Consultant shall carry out the following tasks:

Task 1. Review of Program Documentation

The Consultant shall review and analyze all relevant Program documents, including but not limited to:

  • Loan Agreement and Schedules (including DLIs/DLRs);
  • Program Appraisal Document (PAD), including Results Framework;
  • Disbursement and Financial Information Letter (DFIL);
  • Environmental and Social Systems Assessment (ESSA);
  • Program Action Plan (PAP);
  • Applicable World Bank PforR policies and guidance notes.

Task 2. Design of the POM Structure

The Consultant shall design a logical, user-friendly, and World Bank–compliant structure for the POM, covering at minimum:

  • Program overview and legal framework;
  • Program Action Plan;
  • Institutional arrangements, roles, and responsibilities;
  • Planning, budgeting, and implementation arrangements;
  • DLI/DLR implementation and verification protocols;
  • Financial management, disbursement, audit, and fiduciary arrangements;
  • Anti-corruption measures and reporting;
  • Environmental and social systems, including GRM;
  • Digital platform governance and data protection;
  • Monitoring, evaluation, and reporting framework;
  • Amendment, exception, and waiver procedures;
  • Annexes, templates, matrices, and flow diagrams.

Task 3. Drafting of the Program Operational Manual

The Consultant shall prepare a complete draft POM, ensuring that:

  • roles and responsibilities are clearly defined and internally consistent;
  • operational procedures are practical, unambiguous, and implementable;
  • fiduciary, verification, environmental, and social arrangements are clearly articulated;
  • linkages between DLIs/DLRs, PAP actions, verification, and disbursement are explicit;
  • terminology is consistent with the Loan Agreement and PAD.

Task 4. Stakeholder Consultation and Revision

The Consultant shall:

  • present the draft POM to MEF and relevant stakeholders (ELFFMD, FFEL, Participating Banks, as appropriate);
  • incorporate comments and feedback from MEF and the World Bank;
  • prepare a revised and finalized POM acceptable to the World Bank.

 

The World Bank issued a guidance note to facilitate preparation of POM which was already used to prepare a POM for an Energy Project tin Uzbekistan. These two documents are intended for Investment Project Financing and while not all guidance or sections may be relevant the Consultant is strongly encouraged to use them for task 2 and task 3.  These documents will be provided separately.

4. Deliverables and Timeline

 

Deliverable

Description

Indicative Timing

Deliverable 1

Annotated outline / detailed structure of the POM

Within 10 calendar days

Deliverable 2

First complete draft POM

Within 30 calendar days

Deliverable 3

Revised draft POM reflecting MEF/WB comments

Within 45 calendar days

Deliverable 4

Final POM ready for adoption

Within 60 calendar days

 

 

5. Reporting and Coordination

  • The Consultant will report to the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF).
  • Day-to-day coordination will be carried out with the Education Loan Financing Fund Management Department (ELFFMD).
  • All deliverables shall be submitted in English (editable Word format).

 

6. Required Qualifications and Experience

Education

  • Advanced university degree (Master’s or higher) in public policy, economics, finance, law, public administration, or a related field.

Experience

  • Minimum 15 years of professional experience in managing projects/programs in education sector financed by International Financial Instiututions;
  • Proven experience in World Bank–financed operations, preferably Program-for-Results (PforR);
  • Demonstrated experience in drafting Operational Manuals, POMs, PIMs, or similar operational documents;
  • Strong understanding of fiduciary systems, results-based financing, DLIs/DLRs, and verification arrangements.

Skills

  • Excellent analytical and drafting skills;
  • Ability to translate legal and policy requirements into operational procedures;
  • Familiarity with World Bank fiduciary, environmental, social, and anti-corruption requirements;
  • Strong communication and coordination skills.

 

7. Duration and Level of Effort

The assignment is expected to require up to 60 calendar days over an estimated period of 2–3 months. The contract type is individual consultancy (lump-sum).

8. Confidentiality

All documents, data, and information produced or accessed under this assignment shall remain the property of the Ministry of Economy and Finance and shall not be disclosed without prior written consent.

World Bank Credit Name: Social Assistance System Reform Project in Kosovo
TERMS OF REFERENCE AND SCOPE OF SERVICES
INTRODUCTION
This assignment is implemented under the Social Assistance Reform Project, led by the Department for Social Schemes (DSS) within the Ministry of Labor, Family and Liberation War Values and Social Welfare. The objective of the project is to activate persons who are able to work by removing barriers faced by Social Assistance Scheme (SAS) beneficiaries in their reintegration into the labor market and by promoting their active participation in employment.
Unlike the current scheme, the pilot phase of the reform explicitly encourages the employment of beneficiaries rather than long-term dependency on social assistance. In parallel, the Employment Agency of the Republic of Kosovo is developing a new jobseeker management system, which requires the integration of social assistance components into its design and implementation.
Furthermore, there is a need for dedicated capacity to monitor the performance of employment counsellors, oversee the work of non-public training providers, ensure the quality and proper implementation of training programmes, and contribute to policy development aimed at integrating vulnerable groups into the labor market.
SCOPE OF WORK
In the framework of daily operations, the Activation Consultant will play a central role in strengthening the implementation of the Social Assistance Scheme (SAS) reform by ensuring close and continuous coordination with Employment Counselors across all municipalities. The Consultant will maintain regular communication with municipal employment offices, monitor job placements and activation measures, and organize periodic coordination and review meetings to assess progress, address implementation gaps, and ensure consistency of practices nationwide.
Furthermore, the Activation Consultant will oversee the design, implementation, and quality of training programs for SAS beneficiaries delivered by non-public training providers. This includes monitoring beneficiary participation, progress, and completion rates, ensuring that training activities are aligned with labor market needs, and identifying areas for improvement to increase employability outcomes. The Consultant will also monitor the overall activation process, from referral to employment services through training, job matching, and placement, ensuring that activation pathways are effective, inclusive, and results-oriented.
In addition, the Activation Consultant will contribute to strengthening accountability and evidence-based decision-making within the reform process by systematically collecting and analyzing data on activation outcomes. Regular analytical reports will be prepared, highlighting key achievements, lessons learned, challenges, and structural barriers affecting beneficiary activation and labor market integration. These findings will inform policy adjustments, support continuous improvement of activation measures, and contribute to the successful implementation and sustainability of the social assistance reform.
The Activation Consultant will work in close coordination with ERKR management to support the overall implementation of the Project, provide technical guidance and operational support, ensure effective coordination
among relevant stakeholders, and oversee the planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting of the activation component of the pilot.
QUALIFICATIONS
• Minimum 4 years of relevant professional experience in employment services, labor market policies, social protection, or related fields;
• Proven experience working within the Ministry or in close cooperation with public institutions, particularly in areas related to employment and social assistance reform.
• Experience collaborating with or supporting the Employment Agency of the Republic of Kosovo (EARK), including coordination with employment counselors and implementation of activation measures.
• Bachelor’s degree in economics, social policy, public administration, or a related field (master’s degree is an asset, but not required).
• Good command of English, both written and spoken.
• Practical experience in supporting vulnerable groups through employment services, activation measures, or training programs.
• Familiarity with non-public employment service providers and outsourcing or partnership models is considered an asset.
REMUNERATION
• The Activation Consultant will be engaged on a full-time contractual basis.
• Remuneration will be commensurate with qualifications, professional experience, and level of responsibility, and aligned with Kosovo public sector and donor-funded project standards.
REPORTING RELATIONS AND OBLIGATIONS
The consultant will report directly to the General Secretary of the Ministry, while working closely on a day-to-day basis with the Project Coordinator. The consultant is also expected to maintain close coordination with the World Bank team responsible for the project.

Date: 06 March 2026 Location: Kosovo Project ID: P171098 Ref. No.: SAS.1.1.ICS.009A World Bank Credit Name: Social Assistance System Reform Project in Kosovo
REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST
Engagement of 15 Employment Counselors to Increase the Capacity of the Employment Agency of the Republic of Kosovo (EARK) in Implementing the Activation Pilot
TERMS OF REFERENCE
BACKGROUND
The Ministry of Labour, Family and Liberation War Values (MLFLWV) in the Republic of Kosovo has received a credit from the International Development Association (IDA) in the amount of EUR 47 million to finance the Social Assistance System Reform Project of Kosovo. The objective of the Project is to improve the equity and adaptability of Kosovo’s social protection system.
Improving equity includes selecting SAS beneficiaries based on poverty status. Improving adaptability refers to increasing the capacity of Kosovo’s social protection system to respond to changes in poverty levels, as well as to shocks, including those
induced by climate change, in order to minimize negative impacts on household poverty levels. In this context, MLFLWV is piloting a new tool to identify poor households eligible for SAS support, and the reform is advancing the methods of interaction between the Centers for Social Work (CSW) and the Employment Agency of the Republic of Kosovo (EARK), which is responsible for coordinating employment services for SAS beneficiaries. This reform is accompanied by support for integrating SAS beneficiaries into the labor market. The combination of these factors has increased the demand for services provided by EARK.
In addition to the counselors previously engaged, MLFLWV intends to hire 15 Employment Counselors until the end of 2026 to increase the capacity of Employment Offices during the implementation of the Activation Pilot Program for work-able SAS beneficiaries, as part of the Government’s SAS reform plans. Recruitment will take place in the following municipalities:
• Artana Municipality – one (1) position;
• Graçanica Municipality – one (1) position;
• Hani i Elezit Municipality – one (1) position;
• Istog Municipality – one (1) position;
• Junik Municipality – one (1) position;
• Leposavić Municipality – one (1) position;
• North Mitrovica Municipality – one (1) position;
• Obiliq Municipality – one (1) position;
• Rahovec Municipality – one (1) position;
• Skenderaj Municipality – one (1) position;
• Štrpce Municipality – one (1) position;
• Viti Municipality – one (1) position;
• Vushtrri Municipality – one (1) position;
• Zubin Potok Municipality – one (1) position;
• Zvečan Municipality – one (1) position.
OBJECTIVE OF THE ASSIGNMENT
The main objective of this assignment is to support the Employment Offices in implementing the nationwide pilot program for the activation of work-able SAS beneficiaries, in cooperation with other project and institutional structures.
SCOPE OF WORK
Employment Counselors will work closely with the Director of the Employment Offices and will contribute to achieving the results defined in the Terms of Reference. Under the direct supervision of the Head of the respective Employment Office, specific tasks include:
• Proposing and developing a plan for integrating social assistance beneficiaries into the labor market and monitoring and updating it with six (6) month targets;
• Implementing the Operational Manual for activation of SAS beneficiaries in coordination with the Employment Office;
• Implementing the labor market activation process for the unemployed in cooperation with Employment Offices and Centers for Social Work;
• Providing advice and guidance to applicants regarding employment opportunities and addressing other employment-related issues;
• Conducting profiling according to requirements and guiding SAS Pilot beneficiaries toward suitable employment opportunities;
• Identifying key challenges faced by unemployed individuals in labor market integration through in-depth interviews and documenting services provided;
• Maintaining regular communication with SAS Pilot beneficiaries, at least every two weeks, and documenting individual job search efforts;
• Referring beneficiaries to existing labor market activation measures;
• Assisting Employment Office staff in contacting businesses and employers to gather information on vacancies;
• Organizing monitoring visits to oversee implementation of activation measures;
• Verifying work ability criteria and mutual obligations and preparing reports on identified issues;
• Actively participating in seminars, training sessions, and other related activation plan tasks.
DELIVERABLES
Selected Employment Counselors shall submit:
• Bi-weekly summarized information on the status of all SAS Pilot beneficiaries registered at the Employment Offices;
• Monthly, interim, and annual reports.
DURATION AND REMUNERATION
• The assignment is expected to last until the end of 2026, with the possibility of extension;
• Employment Counselors will be paid a monthly gross salary of EUR 561 (including all pension contributions and taxes);
• Counselors are expected to maintain regular physical presence at the assigned Employment Office during the contract period.
REPORTING RELATIONSHIPS
Employment Counselors will report to the Director of the Employment Offices at EARK. An electronic copy of the report shall also be sent to the Director of the Department of Social Schemes and the Project Coordination Unit Coordinator.
The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Paragraph VII, paragraphs 7.34, 7.35, 7.36 and 7.37 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” (July 2016), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant (IC) method as set out in the Procurement Regulations and in line with the evaluation criteria mentioned above.
QUALIFICATIONS AND APPLICATION
Employment Counselors must meet the following profile and specifications:
• University degree in social sciences, economics, or law;
• At least one (1) year of work experience;
• Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the employment sector and skills development;
• Knowledge of the labor market in Kosovo, required skills, job vacancies, and admission requirements;
• Knowledge of the Albanian language and/or one of the official working languages of the respective municipality;
• Willingness to work in Employment Offices within the same region, depending on operational needs.

MINISTRY OF AGRICULTURE, ANIMAL INDUSTRY AND FISHERIES

Uganda Climate Smart Agricultural Transformation Project

Country: Uganda Project ID: P173296 Credit /Loan Number: 7261-UG  Grant Number: E147-UG

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST

(CONSULTING SERVICES – FIRMS SELECTION)

Assignment Title: Provision of services to conduct farmer registration and mapping of 1,200,000 coffee farms and 200,000 cocoa farms for EUDR compliance.

Reference No : UG-MAAIF-526133-NC-RFB

The Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Uganda Climate Smart Agricultural Transformation Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.    

The Consulting services (“the Services”) include (i) generate credible geospatial and legal evidence to support EUDR due-diligence obligations (ii) enable exporters and operators to undertake operator-level risk assessments and issue legally defensible due-diligence statements (iii)ensure the inclusion of smallholder farmers in EU-bound supply chains by providing a public, standardized traceability backbone (iv) reduce duplication, fragmentation, and transaction costs associated with parallel private traceability initiatives and (v) establish a national dataset that supports Sustainable Land Management (SLM), climate-smart extension services, land-use monitoring, certification, and market intelligence for priority export value chains.This consultancy shall be provided for a period on 12 months . 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.agriculture.go.ug

The Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries now invites eligible consulting firms (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. The shortlisting criteria are  (i) Provide at least two contracts for handling geospatial data such as polygons and GPS points in the last five years. (ii) Provide at least two contracts within the last five years for having successfully conducting field-based activities like registration and certification programs or extension services in any of the sectors such as agriculture, education ,health ,transport or any other relevant sector. (iii) At least two contracts executed in the last two years providing community training/sensitisation services. Each Contract must have been implemented for a minimum duration for one (1) year. for a period not acceding a minimum of a year (Please do not submit CVs and biodata of experts at this stage).

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers July 2016” Seventh Edition, September 2025 “Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

Consultants may associate with other firms to enhance their qualifications, but should indicate clearly whether the association is in the form of a joint venture and/or a sub-consultancy. In the case of a joint venture, all the partners in the joint venture shall be jointly and severally liable for the entire contract, if selected.

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Quality and Cost Based section method set out in the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers July 2016 revised September 2025.

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 0900 to 1700 hours East African time, except on public holidays.

La République du Tchad a reçu un Don de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement (IDA) pour financer les activités du Projet pour l’Autonomisation des Femmes et le Dividende Démographique en Afrique Sub-Saharienne Plus (SWEDD+), et à l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce Don pour effectuer des paiements au titre du Marché relatif à la reproduction des boîtes à image,  sous-projet  « Améliorer les compétences de vie et la santé sexuelle et reproductive des adolescents ».

Le Projet pour l’Autonomisation des Femmes et le Dividende Démographique en Afrique Sub-Saharienne Plus (SWEDD+) sollicite des offres de la part de soumissionnaires éligibles et répondant aux qualifications requises pour fournir les équipements objet de cet appel d’offre.

La procédure sera conduite par mise en concurrence nationale en recourant à un Appel d’Offres National (AON) telle que définie dans le « Règlement applicable aux Emprunteurs – Passation des Marchés dans le cadre de Financement de Projets d’Investissement  Directives : « Fournitures, Travaux, Services Autres que des services de Consultants et Services de Consultants de Juillet 2016, révisé en septembre 2017, août 2018 et Novembre 2020» de la Banque Mondiale (« le Règlement de passation des marchés »), et ouverte à tous les soumissionnaires de pays éligibles tels que définis dans les Règles de passation des marchés.

Les Soumissionnaires intéressés et éligibles peuvent obtenir des informations auprès de : Unité de Gestion du Projet SWEDD+, sise au quartier Repos, Rue de 30m, dans le 4ème arrondissement à côté du Lycée de la Liberté. Tel : (+235) 22 53 10 56 Courriel : sweddtchad@gmail.com ; BP : 2268 N’Djaména – Tchad et prendre connaissance des documents d’Appel d’offres à l’adresse e-mail mentionnée ci-dessus de 7 heures à 15 heures 30 minutes tous les jours et les vendredis de 7 heures à 12 heures 30 minutes, heure locale.

Le Dossier d’Appel d’offres en Français peut être acheté par tout Soumissionnaire intéressé en formulant une demande écrite à l’adresse ci-dessous contre un paiement non remboursable de 50 000 FCFA. La méthode de paiement sera en espèces contre reçu. Pour les fournisseurs étrangers qui désirent avoir le dossier via DHL ou autres, le frais de transfert est à la charge du fournisseur. Le dossier d’appel d’offres sera adressé sous pli fermé.

Les offres devront être remises à l’adresse ci-dessous au plus tard le 7 avril 2026 à 10 heures précises, heures locales. La soumission des offres par voie électronique ne sera pas autorisée. Les offres remises en retard ne seront pas acceptées. Les offres seront ouvertes en présence des représentants des soumissionnaires et des personnes présentes à l’adresse mentionnée ci-dessus le 7 avril 2026 à 10 heures 30 minutes, heure locale.

Les offres doivent être accompagnées d’une Garantie de soumission, pour un montant égal au moins à 2% du montant de l’offre.

REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REoI)

 

(INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT)

 

 

CONSULTANT SERVICES FOR MONITORING AND EVALUATION SPECIALIST

 

 

Country:                               Kingdom of Lesotho

Project:                                  Public Sector Foundations for Services Delivery Project (P174171)

Loan No.:                              74920 -LS

Assignment Title:           Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist

Activity Reference No.:  LS-MOFDP-540532-CS-INDV

Issue Date:                           March 06, 2026

 

The Kingdom of Lesotho through the Ministry of Finance and Development Planning (MoFDP) has received financing from the World Bank towards the cost of the Public Sector Foundations for Service Delivery Project and intends to apply part of the proceeds for procurement of consulting services for Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist.

 

The Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist consulting services (“the Services “) include to provide strategic and technical guidance and assistance to the MFDP, which is the lead implementing agency for the PSFSDP, on monitoring, evaluation and reporting activities for the project, in line with the project’s Results Framework.

 

The Monitoring and Evaluation Specialist will be responsible for:

  • Supporting the preparation of quarterly project reports and the project mid-term review, which will take stock of progress related to the project objectives and outcomes, and planned outputs and activities and with special regard to cross-cutting issues of gender and climate.
  • Supporting the preparation of the borrower’s implementation completion report when the project has closed.
  • Providing technical support for the overall coordination and implementation of M&E activities for the project against the Results Framework
  • Reviewing and assessing the adequacy of the existing M&E framework and tools with a view to fine tuning them as necessary
  • Preparing and operationalizing an M&E plan.
  • Providing periodic updates periodic and tracking and monitoring progress on the execution of Implementation Plans for all ongoing and pipeline project activities
  • Regularly collecting data for quantitative and qualitative analyses of achievements against the project Results Framework
  • Managing the project’s information management system to ensure the proper flow of information to and from the operational level to the PIU, and especially the provision of timely and adequate information for decision-making by the PIU and the other implementing counterparts.
  • Reviewing on a regular basis the status of Project implementation to identify corrective measures, bringing to the attention of project management any problems/issues arising thereof which may hinder implementation of the Project or achievement of the project development objective and related indicators.
  • Participating in the World Bank’s implementation support missions, including prior mission arrangements and providing all M&E information required by the mission, especially reports related to the project’s M&E.

 

  • Adhering to the Project Implementation Unit’s reporting obligations, through preparation and submission of periodic M&E reports as prescribed in Project’s statutes and validated by the Project’s Steering Committee.
  • Supporting other generic reporting requirements to factor in M&E issue Support preparation of the Implementation Completion Report Liaising with the communications strategist for dissemination of M&E information
  • Establishing protocols for and operationalize M&E database.
  • Establishing and validating baselines and targets, where necessary.
  • Leading and coordinating the collection of data from implementing Ministries and the PIU team for reporting the status of indicators biannually along with project progress reports to include, inter alia, the status of procurement processes and contract management issues.
  • Verifying the data collected on the project’s progress.
  • Validating progress on the result indicators with the Project Steering Committee.
  • Maintaining proper documentation of the project’s results.
  • Any other work-related tasks assigned by the Project Coordinator.

 

 

The duration of the assignment is two years, subject to satisfactory performance.

 

The expected commencement date is not later than June 01, 2026.

 

The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be accessed at the following website: Tenders - Government of Lesotho

 

or

 

can be obtained at the address given below.

 

or

 

by sending a request to the email addresses below.

 

The Ministry of Finance and Development Planning now invites eligible individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services (attach curriculum vitae with description of experience in similar assignments, similar conditions, etc.). Firms’ staff may express interest through the employing firm for the assignment and, under such situation, only the experience and qualifications of individuals shall be considered in the selection process.

 

The criteria for selecting the Consultant are:

a) Academic Qualifications

  • At least a Master's Degree in the Social Sciences, Economics, Statistics, Project Management, Public Administration or related discipline. Specialized postgraduate training in project management/M&E

 

b) Professional Experience

  • Minimum of five (5) years of working experience in the public sector or with bilateral or multilateral donor-funded programs with at least 3 years of specific responsibility as an M&E specialist
  • Thorough knowledge of Government of Lesotho and donor institutional and organizational structures and operations in general.
  • Experience in report writing in a concise, lucid, and comprehensible manner.

 

c) Knowledge and Skills

  • Knowledge of and practical experience in the M&E field, systems, methods, approaches, tools, M&E plans,  indicators, reporting etc.
  • Strong analytical skills, oral and written communication skills.
    • Strong interpersonal and motivational skills and sensitivity to the local environment as well as the ability to work with minimal supervision.
    • Ability to work effectively under pressure and ability to multi-task.

 

  1. Communication Skills
  • Strong communication and coordination skills and ability to establish good working relationships with colleagues and stakeholders in a sensitive environment.
  • Strong conceptual and analytical skills and excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal and written communication skills in Sesotho and English.

 

d) Computer literacy

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Suite (Word, Excel, Project, and Power-point).

 

e) Language

  • Proficiency in English is a requirement.

 

The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.13, 3.15, and 3.16 of the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” Fifth edition, September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. 

A Consultant will be selected in accordance with Individual Consultant Selection (INDV) method as set out in the Procurement Regulations.

 

Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours from 0900 to 1600 hours.

REPÚBLICA DE ANGOLA

MINISTÉRIO DO PLANEAMENTO

PROJECTO DE ACELERAÇÃO DA DIVERSIFICAÇÃO ECONÓMICA E CRIAÇÃO DE EMPREGO

Emprestimo No.: IBRD-95270

Projecto ID: P178035

 

SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÕES DE INTERESSE

Serviços de Consultoria – Consultor Individual

VAGA: Consultor Para Recolha De Dados Qualitativos E Elaboração Do Relatório De Diagnostico Das Mulheres Comerciantes Nas Fronteiras

REF.: 89CS1/MINPLAN/26

O Governo de Angola solicitou um crédito ao Banco Internacional de Reconstrução e Desenvolvimento (IBRD) do Grupo Banco Mundial para o financiamento do Projecto de Aceleração da Diversificação Económica e Criação de Emprego (DIVERSIFICA MAIS). O Projecto tem como objectivo aumentar o investimento privado e o crescimento das Micro, Pequenas e Médias Empresas (MPMEs) em sectores não-petrolíferos, com foco no corredor do Lobito por isso, pretende aplicar parte dos recursos do financiamento para a contratação dos serviços de um consultor individual para a posição de Consultor para Recolha de dados qualitativos e elaboração do relatório de diagnostico das mulheres comerciantes nas fronteiras.

O objectivo geral da contratação é o da recolha de dados qualitativos, tratamento e análise de dados quantitativos e qualitativos, e, elaboração do Relatório de Diagnóstico das Mulheres nas Fronteiras do Luvo e do Luau, fornecendo evidência analítica que sustente a tomada de decisão programática do Projecto.

Os Termos de Referência (TOR) detalhados para o trabalho podem ser obtidos no endereço abaixo.

O Projecto de Aceleração da Diversificação Económica e Criação de Emprego do Ministério do Planeamento convida os consultores individuais elegíveis para manifestarem o seu interesse em fornecer os Serviços. Os Consultores interessados deverão fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e experiência relevante para executar os Serviços. O Consultor deve ter as seguintes qualificações e conhecimentos:

  1. Grau académico mínimo de Licenciatura em Ciências Sociais, Economia, Direito, Comércio e Gestão, Desenvolvimento, Sociologia, Psicologia, Antropologia, Estudos de Género, ou áreas afins;
  2. Formação pós-graduada será considerada uma vantagem.
  3. Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em estudos qualitativos, diagnósticos e outros estudos socioeconómicos;
  4. Experiência comprovada em recolha de dados qualitativos (entrevistas em profundidade, focus groups);
  5. Experiência comprovada em contextos de fronteira, mobilidade humana, com foco em questões sociais e de género será considerada um requisito obrigatório;
  6. Experiência comprovada em contexto de fragilidade, conflito e violência seria uma vantagem ou requisito competitivo;
  7. Experiência comprovada de trabalho com minorias, em particular com mulheres em contextos empresariais e/ou de trabalho informal.
  8. Ter realizado, no mínimo, dois trabalhos sociais de natureza semelhante, em termos de contexto e complexidade, nos últimos quatro anos.
  9. Experiência de trabalho em Angola ou em contextos semelhantes será valorizada;
  10. Experiência na elaboração de relatórios analíticos para projectos financiados por doadores internacionais constitui uma mais-valia.
  11. Capacidade técnica para trabalhar em múltiplos locais (fronteiras);
  12. Possuir os meios e equipamentos adequados para garantir a segurança e confidencialidade dos dados recolhidos;
  13. Experiência local e bons conhecimentos do quadro jurídico e regulamentar relacionado com o comércio fronteiriço de Angola, são uma mais-valia;
  14. Habilidades para apresentar questões técnicas complexas;
  15. Fluência em português falado e escrito é obrigatória;
  16. Fluência num dos idiomas locais constitui uma vantagem;
  17. Excelente capacidade de comunicação, elaboração de relatórios e sentido de organização.
  18. Conhecimentos comprovados de métodos quantitativos, qualitativos e triangulação de dados;
  19. Conhecimentos comprovados sobre desigualdades de género e metodologias sensíveis a estas dinâmicas seria uma vantagem;
  20. Excelente capacidade de redação técnica;
  21. Domínio de ferramentas de análise de dados (Excel, software qualitativo, quando aplicável).

O contrato inicial terá uma duração de 90 dias, podendo ser prorrogado mediante acordo entre as partes.

Chama-se atenção dos consultores interessados deve recair sobre a Seção III, parágrafos, 3.14, 3.16 e 3.17 do “Regulamento de Aquisições dos Mutuários do IPF” do Banco Mundial revisada em Setembro de 2025 (“Regulamentos de Aquisições”), estabelecendo a política do Banco Mundial sobre conflito de interesses.

Um Consultor será selecionado de acordo com o método de selecção ICS (Consultor Individual) estabelecido nos Regulamentos de Aquisições do Banco Mundial.

Mais informações podem ser obtidas, apenas por e-mail, no endereço abaixo, durante o horário das 8h00 às 15h00, de segunda a sexta-feira, horário de Angola.

As manifestações de interesse deverão ser entregues, apenas por e-mail, no endereço abaixo indicado até ao dia 26 de Março de 2026, acompanhada da seguinte documentação:

  1. Curriculum Vitae;
  2. Fotocópia do Bilhete de Identidade;
  3. Fotocópia do(s) documentos escolares.
  4. Avaliação de Desempenho.

As manifestações de Interesse a serem recebidas serão avaliadas em duas fases: 

  • Avaliação curricular (obrigatória); 
  • Entrevista (somente para quem passar na avaliação curricular);

SELECTION DE CONSULTANTS

 

NOM DU PAYS : TCHAD

 

NOM DU PROJET : PROJET D’AMELIORATION DES RESULTATS D’APPRENTISSAGE DE L’EDUCATION DE BASE (PARAEB)

                              

Recrutement d’un cabinet international pour un contrat cadre de recrutement de personnel des projets sur financement de la banque mondiale.

 

N° de Don : E-180 / P175803

No. de référence (selon le Plan de Passation des marchés) : TD-CILOP-539295-CS-CQS

 

Le Gouvernement de la République du Tchad a reçu un Don de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA), et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie du montant de ce Don pour effectuer les paiements au titre du contrat suivant : recrutement d’un cabinet international pour un contrat cadre de recrutement de personnel des projets sur financement de la banque mondiale.

 

Les services comprennent (i) la préparation et la publication de l’avis de recrutement à travers quelques journaux d’annonce légale de N’Djaména, (ii) la réception des dossiers de candidature, (iii) l’envoi au client de la copie complète de tous les dossiers de candidature, (iv) l’évaluation des dossiers de candidature y compris les entretiens, (v) l’élaboration de deux rapports : un rapport de présélection et un rapport de sélection finale comportant une liste de trois (3) candidats retenus par poste et par ordre de mérite, etc.

 

 

  1. Objectif de la consultation

 

L’objectif de la consultation est le recrutement du personnel selon l’expression de besoins formulée par le Gouvernement. Il peut aussi être demandé au Cabinet de recruter du personnel complémentaire dont le nombre et les qualifications dépendent de chaque projet.

Le cabinet sera accompagné dans ses tâches par un comité qui sera mis en place à cet effet. 

 

Les termes de référence (TdR) de la mission pourront être obtenus à l’adresse ci-dessous mentionnée.

 

L’Unité de Coordination et de Gestion du Projet invite les candidats admissibles à manifester leur intérêt à fournir les services décrits ci-dessus. Les Consultants intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et une expérience pertinente pour l’exécution des Services (qualifications, références concernant l’exécution de contrats analogues, expérience dans des conditions semblables, etc.).

  1. Profil du Cabinet

Le cabinet de gestion des ressources humaines doit avoir une expérience d’au moins quinze (15) ans dans la problématique de gestion des ressources humaines et ayant conduit au moins cinq (5) missions similaires pour des institutions ou projets financés par les principaux bailleurs de fonds internationaux (Banque Mondiale, BAD, Fonds mondial, Union européenne, ou autres).

Il doit avoir une équipe constituée d’experts ayant une solide expérience dans les domaines du recrutement et de gestion des ressources humaines. 

Dans le dossier de candidature, le cabinet présentera les informations suivantes :

  • Informations générales sur le profil technique du Cabinet ;
  • Organisation et fonctionnement du cabinet ;
  • Références ou expériences du Cabinet dans le domaine du recrutement de différents profils de personnel de projets ou programmes, ou de managers de haut niveau ;
  • Attestation(s) de bonne fin de prestations de service pour au moins trois (3) missions récentes ;
  • Expérience du Chef de mission pour la conduite de la mission, disposant d'un diplôme BAC+5 en ressources humaines ou en sociologie ou autres diplômes connexes et ayant au moins dix (10) années d'expérience dans le domaine. Le chef de mission doit avoir conduit au moins trois (3) missions de recrutement de même envergure avec les références des clients et des années.
  • Membres de l’équipe d’évaluation et leurs CV. 
  1. Durée de la prestation 

La durée de la prestation est de douze (12) mois à partir de la notification du contrat.

Il est porté à l’attention des Consultants que les dispositions des paragraphes 3.14 ; 3.16 et 3.17 de la Section III du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés de la Banque mondiale pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement – 4ème édition de novembre 2020 » relatives aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts s’appliquent.

 

Un Consultant sera sélectionné selon la méthode « Sélection fondée sur les qualifications du consultant (SQC) » telle que décrite dans le « Règlement ».

 

Les Consultants intéressés peuvent obtenir des informations supplémentaires tous les jours ouvrables à l’adresse ci-dessous et aux heures suivantes : Du lundi au jeudi de 8 h 00 à 15 h 00 et le vendredi de 08 heures à 11 h 00.

Les manifestations d’intérêt écrites doivent être déposées à l’adresse ci-dessous en personne, par courrier, ou par courrier électronique au plus tard le 20 mars 2026 à 11h 00 (heure locale).

  1. Le Gouvernement de la République Démocratique du Congo a obtenu un prêt de la Banque mondiale pour financer le Projet d’Urgence et de Résilience Urbaine de Kananga (PURUK). L’Unité de Gestion du PURUK entend utiliser une partie de ces fonds pour financer les paiements relatifs au contrat de services d’un(e) Chargé(e) de Suivi-Evaluation, qui sera basé(e) à Kananga. 
  2. Sous l’autorité du Coordonnateur du Projet et en étroite collaboration avec les autres Spécialistes sera chargé(e) de : (i) Mise en place d’un Système de suivi-évaluation (SSE) pour le projet conformément aux directives de la banque mondiale en termes de gestion axée sur les résultats (ii) Mise en œuvre d’un système de collecte des indicateurs.
  3. Les Termes de Référence (TDR) détaillés pour la mission du Chargé de Suivi-Evaluation au sein de l’UG PURUK, qui font partie intégrante du présent avis à manifestation d’intérêt, sont disponibles en ligne sur médiacongo.
  4. L’Unité de Gestion du PURUK invite, par le présent avis, les candidats individuels qualifiés à manifester leur intérêt pour la prestation des services décrits ci-dessus. Les candidats intéressés doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications et l’expérience requises. Les critères de présélection sont les suivants :
  • Formation académique :

Diplôme universitaire de niveau Bac+5 en économie, gestion et administration, sciences sociales, statistique, informatique, ingénierie ou équivalent ;

Au moins deux formations complémentaires en technique de Suivi évaluation ((les certificats de formations doivent être joints comme moyen de preuve)

  • Expérience professionnelle :
    Expérience professionnelle avérée minimum de 7 ans don’t au moins 5 ans au poste du chargé ou spécialiste en suivi-évaluation dans de projets financés par de bailleurs fonds. L’expérience de moins d’une année ne sera pas prise en compte.

Une expérience dans le secteur des infrastructures en RDC est un atout,

Une maîtrise des logiciels avec preuve : Excel avancé, Power BI/Tableau (souhaité), bases de données (Access/SQL), outils de collecte mobile (ODK/Kobo/CommCare). Connaissance de logiciels statistiques (SPSS/Stata/R) et SIG (QGIS/ArcGIS) un plus.

Après la présélection, les candidats figurant sur la liste restreinte seront invités à l’interviews. Le résultat de cette interview déterminera le/la candidat(e) à retenir. Les candidatures féminines répondant aux critères ci-dessus sont vivement encouragées.

  1. Il est porté à l’attention des candidats que les dispositions de la Section III, paragraphes 3.14, 3.16 et 3.17 du Règlement de passation des marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant un Financement de Projet d’Investissement (FPI), 7ème édition de septembre 2025, relatives aux règles de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflit d’intérêts, s’applique à la présente mission.
  2. Un(e) candidat(e) sera sélectionné(e) selon la méthode de sélection des consultants individuels par approche ouverte nationale, conformément aux dispositions du Règlement de Passation des Marchés de la Banque mondiale pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de Projets d’Investissement (FPI) – Fournitures, Travaux, Services autres que des Services de Consultants, et Services de Consultants, 7ème édition, septembre 2025.
  3. Les manifestations d’intérêt rédigées en langue française, accompagnées de toutes les pièces justificatives de qualification (lettre de motivation, curriculum vitae détaillé, attestations de services rendus, certificats ou brevets de formation, etc.), doivent être transmises au plus tard le 20 mars 2026 à 00h00 (heure locale), à l’adresse ci-dessous, avec la mention : AMI N° ZR-PURUK-539386-CS-INDV – Recrutement d’un(e) Chargé de Suivi-Évaluation à l’UG-PURUK Kananga
